completion:
Because five tests passed, the best meeting the advertised specifications was 15.5 cm.
3. Only one test was lower than the advertised specification, and it was by less than 0.1 cm (14.9 vs. 15.0 cm).
4. Rounding at one decimal place would make all the tests meet or exceed the advertised specifications:
   14.9 cm rounds up to 15.0 cm
5. At this point, the tests successfully meet the advertised specifications with rounding to one decimal place.
6. The expression “or less” must be used to accurately document the test results: “15.0 cm or less”.
7. If the consumer product comparison test documents a difference in one decimal place greater than the advertised specification, it would be documented as follows: all tests passed except for Test #6, No.1, which was 14.
